messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: SEV2 - host gpu-node-7a12 in us-west-2b reported kernel oops and kubelet not ready. Autopager triggered. Incident: PD-12345. Impact: some Dedicated slots affected.

pagerduty: PD alert: gpu-node-7a12: kernel oops (xid:79) -> auto-evac failed. Escalation to on-call.

Maria O.: acked. I'm on call now, paging infra-hardware if serial attach needed. Starting impact triage.

Jin P.: looking at console logs from the rack serial, pulling last 30s. Can someone paste `kubectl get pods -o wide` for tenant workloads on that node?

David K.: saw a spike in pod restarts from acme-analytics and ml-batch-worker-12. sending `kubectl describe node gpu-node-7a12` now.

Maria O.: output snippet from node describe: ```Non-terminated Pods: (12 in total, 9 running, 3 unknown)  cpu Pressure: False  memory Pressure: False  Conditions: Ready=False (KernelOops)  KubeletReady=False```

Jin P.: console log shows `panic: NVIDIA Xid 79 - GPU hang` then kernel oops and immediate reboot attempt. nvme SMART looks okay for now.

Hardware Team: Received. We'll try serial console attach and check for PCIe resets. If kernel oops repeats we'll schedule RMA.

Maria O.: immediate mitigation: cordon node and start evac of scheduled pods -> `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7a12 && kubectl drain gpu-node-7a12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` (doing now).

pagerduty: Note: auto-evac attempted but some pods stuck in Terminating due to mount teardown. Please track.

David K.: kicked pods, 4/6 migrated to spare capacity in the same AZ; 2 remain Pending due to GPU node affinity. Opening temporary routing fallback to model-variant-small for affected requests to avoid customer errors.

Maria O.: assessing customer impact: acme-analytics had 120 failed inference requests in last 5m, roughly 0.6% of their regional traffic. No broad outage. Logging incident for potential SLA hit.

Jin P.: I'm attaching to serial console now: `screen /dev/ttyUSB0 115200` -> seeing repeated `GPU reset` and `traceback` before oops. Capturing logs to /tmp/gpu-7a12-log.txt.

Hardware Team: if kernel oops persists after warm reboot we want a forced power-cycle and then hardware diagnostics. Are there any alerts from the host BMC?

Maria O.: BMC shows watchdog resets, but IPMI reachable. Doing a soft power-cycle through BMC after current drain finishes.

David K.: Routing fallback in place, telemetry shows latency bump for acme-analytics but error rate falling back down. Notifying SEs.

pagerduty: PD-12345 acknowledged by Maria O. Escalation timer paused.

Jin P.: reboot completed, node came back but kubelet failing healthcheck (CrashLoop with kernel oops on GPU init). Rebooting into older kernel from boot menu to rule out recent kernel regression.

Hardware Team: please keep serial logs. If older kernel still hits Xid 79 we RMA GPU card. We'll standby for thermal and voltage traces.

Maria O.: handoff: I will maintain ownership for 30m while we validate node on older kernel; if still unstable I'll escalate to Hardware Team for RMA and hand to David for post-RMA verification. David, can you take over after 16:30 UTC?

David K.: yep I can take over at 16:30 UTC. I'll coordinate with Hardware Team and SEs for post-fix validation and customer comms.

Jin P.: capturing final logs and attaching to the PD incident: /incidents/PD-12345/attachments/gpu-7a12-logs.txt. Also adding `kubectl get events --all-namespaces` output to the thread.

Maria O.: summary for incident record: root cause suspected: intermittent GPU driver/hardware fault causing Xid79 kernel oops -> kubelet not ready -> partial pod evictions and affinity-induced pending pods. Customer impact limited to small % of regional requests. Next steps: hardware diagnostics -> possible RMA -> post-RMA node validation.

incident-bot: Incident PD-12345 updated: owner=Maria O.; status=mitigating; severity=SEV2; sla-impact=possible.

David K.: I'll draft a quick customer note once we confirm RMA decision. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
